messages.subject: Error on Housing Data Example
messages.body_plain:
Nothing severe, just an extra paren at the end of:

priceCog <- function(x) { list(
  slope = cog(lmCoef(x), desc = "list price slope"),
  meanList = cogMean(x$medListPriceSqft),
  listRange = cogRange(x$medListPriceSqft),
  nObs = cog(sum(!is.na <http://is.na>(x$medListPriceSqft))),
    desc = "number of non-NA list prices")
)}
